criteria.text: The participant has locally advanced (unresectable) or metastatic solid tumor malignancy with documented KRAS G12D mutation, has received prior standard therapy, and the investigator does not see any further clinical benefit from continuing such targeted therapy, or is ineligible to receive standard approved therapies.
For the ASP3082 monotherapy escalation cohorts, the participant has a solid tumor malignancy.
The participant has a known KRAS G12 mutation other than G12D.

For ASP3082 combination therapy with Nab-P+GEM or FOLFIRINOX or NALRIFOX, the participant has metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (mPDAC) that has not been previously treated with chemotherapy.
If the participant received (neo)adjuvant therapy, tumor recurrence or disease progression occurred at least 6 months after completing the last dose of the (neo)adjuvant therapy.

The participant consents to provide a tumor specimen in a tissue block or unstained serial slides or a tumor biopsy (core needle biopsy or excision) obtained after the last interventional treatment, but prior to start of study intervention.
The participant consents to provide a sample for tumor biopsy during the treatment period as indicated in the study protocol.
If the participant cannot provide a fresh tissue biopsy sample, the site consults with the sponsor/study medical monitor.
The participant has at least 1 measurable lesion per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1.
Lesions situated in a previously irradiated area are considered measurable if progression has been demonstrated in such lesions.
The participant has an ECOG performance status of 0, 1 or 2 for dose escalation, and 0 or 1 for dose expansion.
The participant's last dose of prior antineoplastic therapy, including any immunotherapy, was 21 days or 5 half-lives, whichever is shorter, prior to initiation of study intervention administration.
The participant has completed any radiotherapy (including stereotactic radiosurgery) at least 14 days prior to the start of study intervention administration.
The participant has recovered from all radiation-related toxicities, does not require corticosteroids (except physiologic replacement dose), and does not have active radiation pneumonitis.
A 1-week washout is permitted for palliative radiation (<= 2 weeks of radiotherapy) to non-central nervous system disease.

The participant's adverse events (excluding alopecia) from prior therapy have improved to grade 1 or baseline within 14 days prior to start of study intervention (or prior to starting SoC chemotherapy, for first line participants receiving Nab-P+GEM FOLFIRINOX or NALIRIFOX).
The participant has adequate organ function as indicated by protocol laboratory value parameters.
The female participant is not pregnant, confirmed by pregnancy test and medical evaluation by interview.
The female participant is not a woman of childbearing potential (WOCBP).
The female participant is a WOCBP who agrees to follow the contraceptive guidance from the time of informed consent through at least 6 months after study intervention administration.
For EU participants in combination therapy with carboplatin, follow contraception guidelines from the time of informed consent through at least 7 months after the final dose of carboplatin.

For South Korea participants in combination therapy with oxaliplatin, follow contraception guidelines from the time of informed consent through at least 15 months after the final dose of oxaliplatin. For combination therapy with cisplatin, follow contraception guidelines from the time of informed consent through at least 14 months after the final dose of cisplatin.
The female participant agrees not to breastfeed starting at screening and throughout the study period and for 6 months after study intervention administration.
The female participant agrees not to donate ova starting at first dose of study intervention and throughout the study period and for 6 months after study intervention administration.
The male participant with female partner(s) of childbearing potential agrees to use contraception throughout the treatment period and for 3 months after study intervention administration.
The male participant agrees not to donate sperm during the treatment period and for 3 months after study intervention administration.

For South Korea participants in combination therapy with oxaliplatin, follow contraception guidelines from the time of informed consent through at least 12 months after the final dose of oxaliplatin. For combination therapy with cisplatin, follow contraception guidelines from the time of informed consent through at least 11 months after the final dose of cisplatin.

The male participant with pregnant partner(s) agrees to remain abstinent or use a condom for the duration of the pregnancy throughout the study period and for 3 months after study intervention administration.
The participant agrees not to participate in another interventional study while receiving study intervention.

For ASP3082 Combination Therapy with Pembrolizumab (Cohort G), or Platinum-based Chemotherapy + Pemetrexed +/- Pembrolizumab (Cohort H), the participant has pathologically documented locally advanced or metastatic (unresectable Stage IIIB-IV) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with KRAS G12D mutation.
The participant has received prior platinum-containing chemotherapy.

The participant has never received systemic therapy for locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with no oncogenic driver mutations, except up to 1 cycle of SoC pembrolizumab or platinum-based chemotherapy ± pembrolizumab prior to Screening with a 21-day washout before C1D1. Participants who received adjuvant or neoadjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy and developed recurrent or metastatic disease more than 12 months after completing therapy may be enrolled.
The participant has received investigational therapy within 21 days or 5 half-lives, whichever is shorter, prior to start of study intervention.
The participant has symptomatic or untreated central nervous system (CNS) metastases.
The participant has leptomeningeal disease as a manifestation of the current malignancy.
The participant has a prior malignancy active (i.e., requiring treatment or intervention) within the previous 2 years, except for local malignancies that have been apparently cured.
The participant has a known or suspected hypersensitivity to ASP3082 or any components of the formulation used.
The participant has active hepatitis B or hepatitis C virus (RNA detected by qualitative assay).
The participant has a known history of human immunodeficiency virus [HIV] infection.

The participant has had a myocardial infarction or unstable angina within 6 months prior to the start of study intervention, has a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) < 50%, or currently has an uncontrolled illness including symptomatic congestive heart failure, clinically significant cardiac disease, unstable angina pectoris, cardiac arrhythmia, obligate use of a cardiac pacemaker, or long QT syndrome.
The participant has a corrected QT interval (QTcF) > 450 msec (men) or >470 msec (women) during screening.
The participant has received prior treatment with a specific KRAS G12D inhibitor/degrader or pan-RAS inhibitor/degrader targeting KRAS G12D.
The participant has an active infection requiring intravenous antibiotics within 14 days prior to study intervention.
The participant is expected to require another form of antineoplastic therapy while on study treatment.
The participant has any condition which makes the participant unsuitable for study participation.
The participant has had major surgery within 4 weeks prior to first dose of study intervention.
The participant has a history of prior discontinuation of cetuximab treatment due to toxicity or intolerance of cetuximab.
The participant has a history of interstitial lung disease requiring systemic steroid treatment.

P1.text: Participant has locally advanced (unresectable) or metastatic solid tumor malignancy with documented Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene homolog \[KRAS\] G12D mutation and has received prior standard therapy and the investigator does not see any further clinical benefit from continuing such targeted therapy, or is ineligible to receive standard approved therapies (no limit to the number of prior treatment regimens).

P2.text: For the ASP3082 monotherapy escalation cohorts, participants with solid tumor malignancies are allowed to be enrolled.

P3.text: Participants with other known KRAS G12 mutations will not be eligible for the study

P4.text: For ASP3082 combination therapy with Nab-P+GEM or FOLFIRINOX or NALRIFOX: Participant must have mPDAC that has not been previously treated with chemotherapy.

P5.text: If a participant received (neo)adjuvant therapy, tumor recurrence or disease progression must have occurred at least 6 months after completing the last dose of the (neo)adjuvant therapy.

P6.text: Participant consents to provide tumor specimen in a tissue block or unstained serial slides or a tumor biopsy (core needle biopsy or excision) obtained after the last interventional treatment, but prior to start of study intervention.

P7.text: Participant also consents to provide a sample for tumor biopsy during the treatment period as indicated in the study protocol.

P8.text: If a participant cannot provide a fresh tissue biopsy sample, the site should consult with the sponsor/study medical monitor.

P9.text: Participant has at least 1 measurable lesion per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1.

P10.text: Lesions situated in a previously irradiated area are considered measurable if progression has been demonstrated in such lesions.

P11.text: Participant has an ECOG performance status of 0, 1 or 2 for dose escalation, and 0 or 1 for dose expansion.

P12.text: Participant's last dose of prior antineoplastic therapy, including any immunotherapy, was 21 days or 5 half-lives, whichever is shorter, prior to initiation of study intervention administration.

P13.text: Participant has completed any radiotherapy (including stereotactic radiosurgery) at least 14 days prior to the start of study intervention administration.

P14.text: Participants must have recovered from all radiation-related toxicities, not require corticosteroids (NOTE: Physiologic replacement dose of hydrocortisone or its equivalent \[defined as up to 30 mg per day of hydrocortisone, 2 mg per day of dexamethasone, or up to 10 mg per day of prednisone\] is permitted), and not have active radiation pneumonitis.

P15.text: A 1-week washout is permitted for palliative radiation (\<= 2 weeks of radiotherapy) to non-central nervous system disease.

P16.text: Participant's adverse events \[AEs\] (excluding alopecia) from prior therapy have improved to grade 1 or baseline within 14 days prior to start of study intervention (or prior to staring SoC chemotherapy, for first line (1L) participants receiving Nab-P+GEM FOLFIRINOX or NALIRIFOX.

P17.text: Participant has adequate organ function as indicated by protocol laboratory value parameters (If a participant has received a recent blood transfusion, the laboratory tests must be obtained \>= 14 days after any blood transfusion.).

P18.text: Female participant is not pregnant, confirmed by pregnancy test and medical evaluation by interview, and at least 1 of the following conditions apply:

P19.text: Not a woman of childbearing potential (WOCBP).

P20.text: WOCBP who agrees to follow the contraceptive guidance from the time of informed consent through at least 6 months after study intervention administration.

P21.text: EU only: For combination therapy with carboplatin, follow contraception guidelines from the time of informed consent through at least 7 months after the final dose of carboplatin.

P22.text: South Korea only: For combination therapy with oxaliplatin, follow contraception guidelines from the time of informed consent through at least 15 months after the final dose of oxaliplatin. For combination therapy with cisplatin, follow contraception guidelines from the time of informed consent through at least 14 months after the final dose of cisplatin.

P23.text: Female participant must agree not to breastfeed starting at screening and throughout the study period and for 6 months after study intervention administration.

P24.text: Female participant must not donate ova starting at first dose of study intervention and throughout the study period and for 6 months after study intervention administration.

P25.text: Male participant with female partner(s) of childbearing potential (including breastfeeding partner) must agree to use contraception throughout the treatment period and for 3 months after study intervention administration.

P26.text: Male participant must not donate sperm during the treatment period and for 3 months after study intervention administration.

P27.text: South Korea only: For combination therapy with oxaliplatin, follow contraception guidelines from the time of informed consent through at least 12 months after the final dose of oxaliplatin. For combination therapy with cisplatin, follow contraception guidelines from the time of informed consent through at least 11 months after the final dose of cisplatin.

P28.text: Male participant with pregnant partner(s) must agree to remain abstinent or use a condom for the duration of the pregnancy throughout the study period and for 3 months after study intervention administration.

P29.text: Participant agrees not to participate in another interventional study while receiving study intervention (Participants who are currently in the follow-up period of an interventional clinical trial are allowed).

P30.text: For ASP3082 Combination Therapy with Pembrolizumab (Cohort G), or Platinum-based Chemotherapy + Pemetrexed +/- Pembrolizumab (Cohort H): Participant must have pathologically documented locally advanced or metastatic (unresectable Stage IIIB-IV) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) (Note: for Cohort H only, the tumor must be non-squamous NSCLC) with KRAS G12D mutation and

P31.text: have received prior platinum-containing chemotherapy (safety lead-in only) or

P32.text: have never received systemic therapy (up to 1 cycle of SoC pembrolizumab \[defined as one 21-day cycle of 200 mg\] in Cohort G and up to 1 cycle of SoC platinum-based chemotherapy ± pembrolizumab \[defined as one 21-day cycle of 200 mg\] or pembrolizumab \[defined as one 21-day cycle of 200 mg\] in Cohort H is permitted prior to Screening, provided a 21-day washout occurs before C1D1) for locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with no oncogenic driver mutations. Participants who received adjuvant or neoadjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy and developed recurrent or metastatic disease more than 12 months after completing therapy may be enrolled.

P33.text: Participant has received investigational therapy within 21 days or 5 half-lives, whichever is shorter, prior to start of study intervention.

P34.text: Participant has symptomatic or untreated central nervous system (CNS) metastases.

P35.text: Participant has leptomeningeal disease as a manifestation of the current malignancy.

P36.text: Participant has a prior malignancy active (i.e., requiring treatment or intervention) within the previous 2 years, except for local malignancies that have been apparently cured, such as basal or squamous cell skin cancer, superficial bladder cancer or carcinoma in situ of the cervix or breast, which are allowed.

P37.text: Participant has a known or suspected hypersensitivity to ASP3082 or any components of the formulation used.

P38.text: Participant with active hepatitis B (including acute hepatitis B virus \[HBV\] or chronic HBV) or hepatitis C virus \[HCV\] (ribonucleic acid \[RNA\] detected by qualitative assay). HCV RNA testing is not required in participants with negative HCV antibody testing.

P39.text: Participant has a known history of human immunodeficiency virus \[HIV\] infection.

P40.text: Participant has had a myocardial infarction or unstable angina within 6 months prior to the start of study intervention, left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) \< 50% as determined by multigated acquisition (MUGA) scan or echocardiogram (ECHO) or currently has an uncontrolled illness including, but not limited to symptomatic congestive heart failure, clinically significant cardiac disease, unstable angina pectoris, cardiac arrhythmia, obligate use of a cardiac pacemaker, or long QT syndrome.

P41.text: Participant has a corrected QT interval (single electrocardiogram \[ECG\]) using Fridericia's formula (QTcF) \> 450 milliseconds (msec) (men) or \>470 msec (women) during screening.

P42.text: Participant has received prior treatment with a specific KRAS G12D inhibitor/degrader or pan-RAS inhibitor/degrader targeting KRAS G12D. Participants who received prior treatment with a KRAS G12D inhibitor/degrader are eligible for the ASP3082 combination therapy cohort.

P43.text: Participant has an active infection requiring intravenous antibiotics within 14 days prior to study intervention.

P44.text: Participant is expected to require another form of antineoplastic therapy while on study treatment.

P45.text: Participant has any condition which makes the participant unsuitable for study participation (such as psychiatric illness/social situations that would limit compliance with study requirements).

P46.text: Participant has had major surgery within 4 weeks prior to first dose of study intervention.

P47.text: Prior discontinuation of cetuximab treatment due to toxicity or intolerance of cetuximab.

P48.text: History of interstitial lung disease requiring systemic steroid treatment. Note that a participant with resolved pulmonary infections or radiation pneumonitis is eligible.

transcript.text: These questions are about the trial "A Study of ASP3082 in Adults With Advanced Solid Tumors". Your earlier answers already covered 11 of its rules. I'll ask about the rest of its rules one at a time. You can skip any question, and "I don't know" is always fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you been diagnosed with a solid tumor malignancy? (This refers to a cancer that forms in solid tissues like organs or bones, rather than in the blood.)

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I have non-small cell lung cancer, which is a solid tumor.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you know if your tumor has a KRAS G12 mutation other than G12D? (This is a specific genetic change in the cancer cells. If you aren't sure, that's okay.)

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know. My report just said KRAS negative, so I'm not sure about specific subtypes like G12C or G12V.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. For this part of the study, have you ever received chemotherapy for your pancreatic cancer?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't have pancreatic cancer; I have non-small cell lung cancer. I also haven't had any chemotherapy.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks for clarifying. Since you haven't had chemotherapy, did you receive any other treatments (like surgery or targeted therapy) before starting your current cancer care, and if so, did your cancer come back or progress more than 6 months after finishing that treatment?

transcript.speaker: participant

transcript.text: Thanks. Are you currently post-menopausal, or have you had a hysterectomy or bilateral oophorectomy (removal of both ovaries)?

transcript.text: Thanks. Are you currently participating in any other interventional clinical studies?

transcript.text: Thanks. Have you had any other cancer diagnosis in the last 2 years that is still active or requires treatment? (This excludes skin cancers or other local cancers that have been fully cured.)

transcript.speaker: participant

transcript.text: Thanks. Do you have any known allergies or hypersensitivity to ASP3082 or any of the ingredients in this medication?

transcript.speaker: participant

transcript.text: Thanks. Have you received any intravenous antibiotics for an active infection in the last 14 days?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had any intravenous antibiotics for an active infection in the last 14 days.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you expect to need any other cancer treatments (antineoplastic therapy) while participating in this study?

transcript.speaker: participant

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you have any other health conditions or issues that might make it difficult for you to participate in this study?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I have Crohn's disease, which is an autoimmune condition. I'm currently taking Humira to manage it.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks for sharing that. To help us understand if Crohn's disease affects your ability to join this study, could you tell us if you have had any serious complications or hospitalizations related to it in the past year?

transcript.speaker: participant

transcript.text: Thanks. Have you had any major surgery in the last 4 weeks? (Major surgery means a procedure requiring an incision and anesthesia, like an appendectomy or knee replacement.)

transcript.speaker: participant

transcript.text: Have you ever stopped taking a medicine called cetuximab because of side effects or because you couldn't tolerate it?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know. I have never taken cetuximab, so I haven't stopped it due to side effects.

transcript.text: Thank you, that's all my questions. Your record for this trial is ready, for you and your oncologist. They and the trial team decide whether it is right for you.
